title: Running the Titan_ClearLabs Workflow on Terra.bio
author: Frank J Ambrosio
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzygp7tw

steps.title: Access the Titan_ClearLabs Workflow
steps.instruction: Navigate to the Titan_ClearLabs assembly workflow page within the Terra.bio workspace.

substeps.instruction: Click on the 'Workflows' panel in the workspace.

steps.title: Configure Workflow Version and Settings
steps.instruction: Select the appropriate workflow version and enable data processing settings.

substeps.instruction: Select the latest stable version of the workflow (avoid 'main' or 'dev' versions).
Ensure 'Run workflow(s) with inputs defined by data table' is selected.
Select the root entity type for the data to be analyzed.

steps.title: Select Samples for Analysis
steps.instruction: Choose the specific samples to be processed by the workflow.

substeps.instruction: Choose the samples you wish to analyze.

steps.title: Complete the INPUTS Form
steps.instruction: Define the input variables by mapping them to the data table attributes and workspace elements.

substeps.instruction: For the 'clear_lab_fastq' variable, enter 'this.clearlabs_fastq_gz' in the Attribute text box (or 'this.' followed by your specific column name).
For the second row, input the desired primer_bed file saved as a workspace element in Terra.
For the 'samplename' variable, enter 'this.clearlabs_specimen_id' in the Attribute text box (or 'this.' followed by your specific column name).

steps.title: Configure OUTPUTS and Save
steps.instruction: Set the output parameters and save the configuration to enable analysis.

substeps.instruction: In the OUTPUTS form, select 'Use Defaults'.
Click the 'Save' button to apply changes.
Verify that yellow caution icons have disappeared and the 'Run Analysis' option is available.

steps.title: Launch the Analysis
steps.instruction: Execute the workflow and monitor the job progress.

substeps.instruction: Click the 'Run Analysis' button to the right of the 'Outputs' tab.
In the 'Confirm launch' popup window, click the 'Launch' button.
Monitor the 'Job History' panel to track status changes from queued to submitted to running.
